about: A small sack held at its tied neck: the grip is at the origin (her fist) and the bag hangs below it. 'variants' colour it per kind: 0 pumpkin seeds, 1 cabbage seeds, 2 hen feed (the code picks the number). Sizes and positions are in metres as [x across, y up, z forward]; turns are in degrees. A box's at is its middle, measured from its part. Edit, save and reload the page. A note is only a label for you.
